strategy_formula: fused_score = max(rf_attack_probability, ae_norm); attack = fused_score > fused_decision_threshold
confidence_threshold_note: SUPERSEDED. Belongs to the retired `confidence_weighted` cascade and is NOT used by `rf_ae_or`. Kept only so that strategy stays reproducible and so src/evaluation/eval_test_set_ensemble.py's config/module consistency assertions still have a key to compare.
tuning_objective: Nested LOAO (zero-day) F1 on train-fold-normalized scores -- thresholds selected on the other nine categories and applied to the held-out one. NOT validation-selected.
isolation_forest_role: Excluded from the deployed OR. IF-v2's LOAO false-positive rate is ~0.095, roughly 10x RF's and AE-v2's, so ORing it in raises system FPR for little recall. Still scored and normalized at inference for metadata/explanation use only.

normalization.note: TRAIN-fitted with the deployed models, matching what each LOAO fold does with its own train fold, so the LOAO-selected decision threshold transfers. Fit once, reused as-is at inference -- never refit per request. Superseded val-fit constants had ae_max=0.8110765814781189, 6.6x the true train-fit value, which would have shrunk every deployed ae_norm by that factor and made the LOAO-tuned threshold unreachable, silently silencing the detector.

loao_evaluation.threshold_stability: Nested selection chose 0.05 in every one of the 10 held-out folds, and tuned-on-all selection chose 0.05 as well -- the operating point is fold-stable, not fitted to one category.

known_limitations: Bot: nested LOAO recall 0.028. Every member is near-zero here (RF 0.014, IF-v2 0.023, AE-v2 0.021), so no combination rule recovers it. Unchanged across every evaluation in this thesis.

FTP-Patator: RF solo reaches 1.000 nested recall at its own swept threshold while both unsupervised members sit at 0.001. The OR keeps RF's contribution, but this category depends entirely on RF -- there is no redundancy if RF degrades.
PortScan: depends entirely on AE-v2 (0.731 nested) -- RF solo is 0.035. Same single-member-dependency caveat as FTP-Patator, mirrored.

Isolation Forest contributes nothing to the deployed decision. The 'three-model ensemble' framing in the architecture diagrams no longer matches what actually decides an alert; the deployed detector is RF + AE-v2.

No SHAP-based explainability. The architecture description's 0-100 risk score with SHAP attribution remains unbuilt; alert_dispatcher derives its 0-100 display score by clamping and scaling fused_score, which is not an attribution method.

Normalized scores are intentionally unclipped, so fused_score can exceed 1.0 for rows more anomalous than anything in the training population. Consumers that need a bounded score must clamp at the presentation boundary.

superseded_history.confidence_weighted: Retired. RF-primary cascade with an IF-v2/AE-v2 mean fallback. Nested LOAO F1 0.8324, statistically indistinguishable from RF alone (0.8327) -- the cascade added complexity without adding detection. Its own tuner selected confidence_threshold=1.00 in 9/10 nested folds, i.e. it switched the RF-primary design off and fell back to the unsupervised mean almost always.
superseded_history.test_fold_normalization_bug: All LOAO reports produced before this evaluation normalized each fold's zero-day test scores with that same test fold's own min/max, making them invalid held-out estimates. They are preserved under *_legacy_test_fold_normalization.csv names. Correcting the bug improved every candidate by roughly 1-4pp but did not change their ranking.
superseded_history.val_selected_thresholds: confidence_threshold=0.10 / fused_decision_threshold=0.30 were validation-selected placeholders used while the corrected LOAO run was pending. Both are superseded.
